frozen_before: local full source grid rerun; archived result and exploratory 85-rune plant outcomes were already known
question: Can the source-specific 1-or-2 advance beam with three named long keys recover a complete LP2 page?
exact_executable_rule: For every ciphertext rune, every beam state may advance key position by 1 or 2, without requiring a doublet collision. Decoder keeps highest incremental score per key position and prunes globally to 120 states. Final winner uses source normalized quadgram score; source threshold >−5.0.
source_prose_caveat: The source calls this a doublet-avoiding cipher, but its executable decoder does not restrict extra advances to would-be ciphertext doublets. Result is for the executable unconstrained beam only.
manuscript_grid: Rerun original source program in isolated temporary copy: six longest rune-bearing unsolved source pages, source page indices chosen by descending length with index tie order; three committed key texts (Tao Te Ching, Gospel of Thomas, Cicada PGP prose); offsets 0, floor(key length/4), floor(key length/2); 54 page/key/offset settings. Compare full source best/top and threshold. Store all54 decoded scores, output lengths and hashes in addition to source top15.
positive_controls: For each of three texts and three source offsets, plant the GP29 documented LP2-56 reading at length85 and its deterministic repeated prefix at length273. Two encryption schedules: normal advance1 and collision skip (advance2 only if proposed output repeats previous ciphertext). Decode with source beam120. Record full text equality and score>−5.0 separately; do not use an English-like score as evidence of exact recovery. Plant construction and planned lengths fixed before manuscript rerun.
null_control: No manuscript-rune shuffle control if the collision-skip positive fails exact recovery; source score threshold will be reported as a screen, not a calibrated probability.
corpus: Pinned krisyotam rune-only 57 segments; source indices 0–49 map to LP2-00–49, source 50–56 to LP2-51–57. The source filters out the rune-free LP2-50 transcription segment.
limits: Only three fixed texts, three coarse offsets and six longest pages; no arbitrary keys, all offsets, or collision-only decoder. Beam prunes and merges states; source score may accept incorrect reconstructions. Not a test of all running-key ciphers.
